questions.q: What is the main goal of Spring AI?
options: Train new language models in Java
Give Java/Spring apps one portable API to use AI models
questions.why: Spring AI is for using models inside applications through a portable API, not for training them.

questions.q: An LLM generates its answer by…
options: Predicting the next token, over and over
questions.why: An LLM is a next-token predictor. Tools and RAG add web/DB access later.

questions.q: You send two requests to a model. Does the model remember the first one when answering the second?
options: No: models are stateless, the app must send the history
questions.why: Models are stateless; Spring AI's chat memory resends the conversation.

questions.q: In the Spring AI layers, what sits directly under the ChatClient?
questions.why: ChatClient (fluent API) → ChatModel (portable interface) → provider module.

questions.q: How do you move an app from Ollama to OpenAI?
options: Swap the starter dependency and the properties
questions.why: Your code targets the portable API; the provider is configuration.

questions.q: How do you usually get a ChatClient in a Spring Boot app with a model starter?
questions.why: The starter auto-configures a ChatClient.Builder bean.

questions.q: Which call chain returns the answer as a String?
questions.why: call() is the blocking call; content() returns the text.

questions.q: You need the token usage of a call. What do you use instead of content()?
questions.why: chatResponse().getMetadata().getUsage() exposes prompt/completion/total tokens.

questions.q: Where do you set a system message that applies to every request of a ChatClient?
questions.why: defaultSystem on the builder; .system(..) per request overrides it.

questions.q: Which method returns a Flux<String> for streaming?
questions.why: stream() is the reactive counterpart of call().

questions.q: Which message type sets the model's role, rules and tone?
questions.why: System messages guide behaviour; user messages carry the request.

questions.q: What is the default placeholder syntax in a PromptTemplate?
questions.why: The default StTemplateRenderer uses { and } delimiters.

questions.q: Which class renders templates by default?
questions.why: It is based on Terence Parr's StringTemplate.

questions.q: Your template must contain JSON with curly braces. What is the cleanest fix?
options: Configure different delimiters (e.g. < >) on the renderer
questions.why: StTemplateRenderer.builder().startDelimiterToken('<').endDelimiterToken('>').

questions.q: Why keep long prompts in a resource file (e.g. classpath:/prompts/review.st)?
options: Versioning, reviews and editing without touching Java code
It is required by Spring AI
Templates in Java do not work
questions.why: Prompts are code: keep them versioned and reviewable.

questions.q: What does a temperature of 0 tend to produce?
questions.why: Low temperature = less randomness in token sampling.

questions.q: Which property sets the Ollama chat model in Spring AI 2.0?
questions.why: 2.0 removed the artificial .options segment from property keys.

questions.q: Default options are set in properties. A request passes its own temperature. Which wins?
questions.why: Runtime options override start-up defaults.

questions.q: How are chat options created in Spring AI 2.0?
options: With builders, and they are immutable
questions.why: 2.0 moved to builder-created, immutable options.

questions.q: What does maxTokens limit?
options: The length of the generated answer
The number of requests per minute
The size of the context window
questions.why: It caps the completion tokens the model may generate.

questions.q: Spring AI is best compared to which Spring project?
options: Spring Data: it hides the provider behind a portable API

questions.q: Which bean does a model starter auto-configure for the fluent API?
Roughly how many English words is 1,000 tokens?
A model states a wrong fact with confidence. This is called…
Which code returns a ChatResponse with metadata?
Where is the token usage?
In 'Summarise {text} in {n} bullets', what are {text} and {n}?
options: Template placeholders filled at render time

questions.q: Which role carries the instructions 'You are a strict code reviewer…'?
You want deterministic unit-test-like answers. Which temperature?
Spring AI 2.0.x requires which Spring Boot line?
Which is NOT a good use of Spring AI?
Where should an OpenAI API key live?

challenge.title: Commit message writer
challenge.task: Build POST /commit-message that receives a git diff as the request body and returns a Conventional Commits message (type(scope): subject, max 72 chars, then a short body).
requirements: Use ChatClient with a defaultSystem prompt that defines the format rules
Keep the user prompt in src/main/resources/prompts/commit.st with a {diff} placeholder
Set temperature to 0.2 for this endpoint only (runtime option)
Log prompt and completion token usage for every call
Run it on Ollama, then switch to another provider with a Spring profile, without code changes
selfCheck: The subject line is ≤ 72 characters for 5 different diffs
The same diff gives very similar messages on 3 runs
No provider name appears in your Java code
